explanation: Clements–Lindström (JCT 1969), as recalled in arXiv:2007.15467: for d_1 ≤ … ≤ d_c, every homogeneous ideal containing x_1^{d_1}, …, x_c^{d_c} has the Hilbert function of a lex-plus-powers ideal L + (x_1^{d_1}, …, x_c^{d_c}) with L lex. The formal statement assumes purePowersIdeal hc d ≤ I with d monotone and concludes exactly this. Faithful.
